prompts: Restyle the signup form in signup.html so it is usable and accessible. Keep it one static file.

checks.name: every input has a label
checks.command: n=$(grep -o '<input' signup.html | wc -l); l=$(grep -oE '<label[^>]*for=' signup.html | wc -l); [ $l -ge $n ] && echo ok $n $l || echo missing $n $l
